document:0:231:0.text:
Keira, thirty days have passed since the war... and only a rushed funeral.

Will no miracle come? You fought for Halia... you were <style="highlight">blessed by the God of Harvest</style>!

Will He <style="highlight">save you again</style>? Like when you were lost in Dregwood, starving, and a <style="highlight">petal umbrella</style> appeared before you?

You told me you saw me and your mother in a dream, and when you woke, we were there.

Others call it a hallucination from the petal umbrella, but we know the truth. It was a miracle. The God of Harvest guided us to you!

And that <style="highlight">wild sandbeast led me there</style>, it was so strong... It surely was <style="highlight">the God's chosen beast</style>!

Keira, I believe you've returned to his embrace. I won't try to take you from His hands. I only pray for one thing...

<style="highlight">Let me see you once more... even if only in my dreams.</style>

奎莉，那场战争已经过去了三十天……只有一场朴素的葬礼。一切都那么草率。
奇迹真的不会发生了吗？明明你是为呼临城而战……你<style="highlight">受丰饶神的庇护</style>啊！
伟大的神，他会不会<style="highlight">再一次救你</style>？就像你误入水淀枯林时那样，在你饥肠辘辘时，将果腹的<style="highlight">弥纹花伞</style>送到你眼前？
你告诉我，你在幻梦中看见了我和你妈妈。当你醒来时，美梦成真，我们真的到了你眼前。
其他人都说，那是因为弥纹花伞致幻。可你我都知道，那是真正的神迹……是丰饶神指引我们找到你的！
<style="highlight">那只为我引路的野猪</style>，它那样强壮……必定是<style="highlight">丰饶神的眷属</style>！
奎莉，我想你已经回到了他的怀抱，我不会妄图从神手中抢走你。我只求神应允我唯一的祈愿：
<style="highlight">让我在梦里，再见你一面……</style>
